visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video employs a split-screen format throughout. In the upper frame, a young woman with long dark hair wearing a black leather jacket stands on a rooftop at night, with blurred city lights in the background. In the lower frame, a man with dark hair in a long dark coat stands in a large hall with gothic-style stone arches and dim, moody lighting. (2) Close-up shots of different individuals are shown. A woman with straight dark hair looks upward with a neutral expression; a man with wavy dark hair looks toward the side. The lighting in these shots is cinematic, with strong highlights and deep shadows, emphasizing their profiles against urban night backgrounds. (3) Transitions show characters in motion. A woman walks while pushing a bicycle in an outdoor street setting at night with green metal railings. Simultaneously, a man is seen in the driver's seat of a car during sunset, with the golden light reflecting off his sunglasses and the vehicle's interior. (4) The sequence continues with more characters in varied indoor and outdoor settings. A woman in a light-colored blouse stands in a modern room with warm lighting. A man stands behind an ornate wooden bar with hanging brass lamps. A different woman in a black top stands on a rooftop overlooking a dense cityscape at dusk. (5) Characters begin to sing with expressive facial movements. One woman holds an acoustic guitar while singing on a rooftop. A man sings passionately in front of the Taipei 101 skyscraper at night. The editing pace increases, showing multiple split-screen combinations of different singers in quick succession. (6) The final shot shows a split screen where the top frame features a woman on the rooftop looking up at the sky. The bottom frame displays a bright classroom full of students in white uniforms; a girl in the foreground is writing in a notebook, then looks up at the camera and smiles warmly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clean, melodic piano melody in a bright major key, accompanied by a subtle electronic atmospheric bed. The mix is studio-grade with zero background noise. (2) A transition sound effect, a sharp 'hit' paired with a synthesizer riser, marks the introduction of the first vocal phrase. A female voice begins singing with a clear, resonant tone and moderate arousal. (3) A percussive kick drum and acoustic guitar strumming enter the mix, significantly increasing the rhythmic intensity and spectral brightness. The tempo is a steady moderate-fast pop beat. (4) Multiple voices, both male and female, begin to layer in harmony. Their delivery is energetic and well-enunciated. Each change in singer is marked by a crisp audio transition that maintains musical flow. (5) The arrangement swells into a full pop-rock chorus with loud, driving drums and soaring electric guitar textures. The vocal intensity reaches a peak with high pitch variability and strong emotional arousal. (6) A final melodic phrase concludes the song as the instruments gradually decrease in complexity, ending on a sustained tonal chord that matches the visual transition to the classroom scene.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Emotional Buildup -> Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a music video for a pop song titled 'Forever Forever'. It uses a split-screen montage to present multiple diverse characters in different life scenarios, all connected by the emotional core of the song. The fast-paced editing and passionate vocal performance aim to inspire feelings of unity, nostalgia, and hope among the audience.
